channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye pursues ‘fair, equitable’ solution to Mideast tensions: Erdoğan
item.description: Türkiye remains firmly committed to a policy centered on peace, amid its efforts to achieve a “fair and equitable solution” to end tensions in the Middle East, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on March 3.

item.title: Istanbul to add 23 new metro stations
item.description: Transport and Infrastructure Minister Abdulkadir Uraloğlu has announced that 23 new metro stations will be added in Türkiye’s largest city by the end of the year, expanding urban rail access across key districts of Istanbul.

item.title: Turkish defense and aerospace exports surge in early 2026
item.description: Türkiye’s defense and aerospace industry recorded a strong performance in February, achieving $553.4 million in exports — a 27.2 percent increase compared to the same month last year.

item.title: Türkiye inks cooperation deal with Canada on nuclear energy
item.description: Türkiye and Canada have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) on cooperation in the field of nuclear energy, Türkiye's energy minister announced on Tuesday.

item.title: EU to unveil 'Made in Europe' rules despite pushback
item.description: The EU will on Wednesday unveil "Buy European" rules to boost domestic production, which Brussels says will help defend European businesses against fierce global competition, especially from China.

item.title: Erdoğan urges diplomacy on Middle East conflict in call with Pakistan’s Sharif
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan held a call Tuesday with Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif about bilateral ties, Iran and regional developments, according to the Turkish Presidency's Directorate of Communications.

item.title: Rate cut expectations fade as oil prices rise amid Mideast tensions
item.description: Rising energy costs triggered by the latest conflict in the Middle East are reshaping monetary policy outlooks across economies, delaying anticipated interest rate cuts.

item.title: Lebanon reports broad Israeli strikes hitting hotel, residential building
item.description: Israeli strikes hit a Beirut hotel and a residential building in Lebanon's east, Lebanese state media said Wednesday, as Israel announced "broad-scale strikes" against Hezbollah after repeated missile and drone launches.

item.title: Fidan calls Iran strikes on Gulf states ‘wrong strategy’ as war spreads
item.description: [08:07, 04.03.2026] Erim: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said Tuesday that Iran’s strategy of bombing all Gulf countries "without making any distinction" was "an incredibly wrong strategy."

item.title: US says 2,000 targets hit as Iran retaliates across Gulf
item.description: Israel early Wednesday launched new attacks on Iran as the U.S. military said it has hit nearly 2,000 targets inside the Islamic republic, which tried to impose a cost by expanding a missile and drone barrage across the region.
